articles.title: Italy’s UniCredit launches six-year bitcoin certificate with gains capped at 65%
articles.snippet: UniCredit brings bitcoin investing to its roughly 8 million retail customers in Italy, offering them a six-year product that caps the redemption value but promises to return their capital.

articles.title: EU proposes $54.7 billion fund for AI, quantum startups alongside post-quantum security push
articles.snippet: Brussels wants tech firms to grow at home. EU scale-ups raise about half the capital of San Francisco peers by year 10, an EIB study found.

articles.title: HYPE drops 8% as Trump bump gives way to 40% slide from peak
articles.snippet: HYPE traded below its price before Trump’s August remarks as wallets linked to Abraxas Capital reportedly exited the Hyperliquid platform.

articles.title: Hyperliquid Leads Altcoin Losses as Bitcoin Slips Below $59K
articles.snippet: HYPE fell more than 8% after Abraxas Capital pulled out of Hyperliquid, while U.S. Bitcoin ETFs' November outflows passed $4.9 billion.

articles.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Insiders Fear Their Next AI Models Are Too Dangerous to Release
articles.snippet: Employees at both AI labs reportedly question whether their strongest models should ever reach the public, as researchers struggle to keep increasingly capable systems under control during training and testing.
